messages:
infra-bot: Pager: high GPU scheduling latency detected in us-west-2. 90th token latency spike > 2s, queue depth increasing. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
michelle.ops: I'm on it — taking bridge. Starting collection of traces + load snapshots. Can someone confirm whether dedicated pools are impacted or just hosted?
sam.platform: Looks like both. Early signs: autoscaler didn't reclaim idle nodes due to kernel OOMs on some instances. Logs pulled at /var/logs/inference/scale.log show repeated preemption messages.
michelle.ops: good catch. sam, paste the tail of the scale logs here?
sam.platform: ```
2026-03-15T08:12:46Z scale-controller: NodeTerminate: i-0abcde preempted by provider
2026-03-15T08:13:02Z scale-controller: FailedLaunch: insufficient capacity error for p4d.24xlarge
2026-03-15T08:14:05Z autoscaler: attemptReconcile -> throttled by quota
```
lorna-pm: tagging this as high customer impact — several enterprise customers reported increased latencies and timeouts to the Hosted API. Need an assessment ASAP for priority routing.
michelle.ops: quick impact note: approx 12% of inference traffic hitting p4d pools in us-west-2. Observed 5xx rate bumped from 0.2% to 1.8% in last 30m. Will update.
raj.sre: I'm joining the bridge (handing oncall). michelle, want to do a short handoff?
michelle.ops: thanks. Handoff: we've isolated the hotspot to the thin-provisioned p4d cluster — provider reports temporary capacity shortage in the AZ. Autoscaler attempted additional nodes but launch failures due to quota/backfill. Immediate mitigation options we tried: 1) route requests to eu-west fallback pool (worked but bumped latency +40ms), 2) burst to reserved dedicated capacity (limited), 3) reduce batching window to lower queue depth.
raj.sre: notes: please run the quick route command to divert non-enterprise routes to eu-west. michelle, can you run?
michelle.ops: running now. Command: 
```bash
rdw routing promote --from-region us-west-2 --to-region eu-west-1 --scope non-enterprise --dry-run=false
```
michelle.ops: done. Routing rule applied; verifying. Request flow shows 30% shifted in last 2m. Customers still on enterprise SLA unaffected by routing change.
sam.platform: I'm opening a temporary capacity request with cloud provider via the console. Also starting a rolling restart on nodes that showed kernel OOM to free up slot churn.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: Route change applied by michelle.ops at 2026-03-15T08:27:12Z.
lorna-pm: michelle, can you post a short customer-impact blurb for CSMs? They want a one-liner and ETA.
michelle.ops: Draft: "We experienced elevated inference latency in us-west-2 due to transient GPU capacity constraints. Non-enterprise traffic has been routed to eu-west-1 to mitigate impact; enterprise customers remain on reserved capacity. We expect normalization within 90 minutes as provider capacity stabilizes." Thoughts?
raj.sre: good. add note about ongoing rollback if capacity returns. also include ticket INFRA-4721 for tracking.
lorna-pm: pinging CSMs now with that text. :loudspeaker:
michelle.ops: provider just acknowledged temporary capacity pressure and expects quota backfill in ~45m. Still seeing intermittent launch failures.
sam.platform: we've patched autoscaler config to tolerate short preemptions and enabled a fallback to cheaper instance types (gpudx-48) for non-sensitive routes. Patch is in PR r/infracfg#512.
raj.sre: can you put the exact autoscaler tweak here so we can record it in the post-incident actions?
sam.platform: sure — diff snippet: 
```diff
- max_unready_nodes: 2
+ max_unready_nodes: 6  # tolerate transient preemptions
- preferred_instance_types: [p4d.24xlarge]
+ preferred_instance_types: [p4d.24xlarge, gpudx-48]  # allow fallback
```
michelle.ops: tracking customer impact: CSM reports 3 enterprise customers noticed spikes; no SLA breaches reported yet. Error budget stress flag set to monitor.
oncall-bridge-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff in 30m. Please confirm bridge owner transfer if needed.
raj.sre: I'll stay on for now; handoff in 30m may be fine. michelle, can you own the postmortem and compilation of logs? You're primary for incident write-up.
michelle.ops: I can. Will open the postmortem page and assign owners. Proposed owner list: michelle.ops (write-up), sam.platform (autoscaler fix), raj.sre (runtime/kernel investigation), lorna-pm (customer comms).
lorna-pm: scheduling PM sync + postmortem workshop for tomorrow 10:00am PT. Can everyone confirm availability?
raj.sre: confirmed.
sam.platform: confirmed.
michelle.ops: confirmed. I'll create the postmortem doc and link actions to INFRA-4721.
michelle.ops: quick check-in — metrics trending: 5xx rate down to 0.5%, 90th token latency back to baseline-ish. Provider reports capacity backfilled.
infra-bot: Incident resolved: state -> contained at 2026-03-15T09:32:00Z.
michelle.ops: Action items (assignments + jira):
- INFRA-4721: postmortem doc + timeline (owner: michelle.ops)
- INFRA-4722: update autoscaler fallback config permanently + unit tests (owner: sam.platform)
- INFRA-4723: add runbook step to route non-enterprise traffic during AZ shortages (owner: raj.sre)
- INFRA-4724: add customer-impact alerting to CSM dashboard (owner: lorna-pm)
- INFRA-4725: follow up with cloud provider on release windows and preemption patterns (owner: michelle.ops)
michelle.ops: I'll drop the postmortem link here once created.
michelle.ops: postmortem created: https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/INFRA-4721  — started timeline and raw logs attached. :spiral_note_pad:
lorna-pm: adding a customer follow-up template to the doc and linking CSM tickets.
raj.sre: scheduling a short retro with infra next week to validate autoscaler tolerances and run the preemption simulator.
sam.platform: I'll implement the autoscaler tests this week and open the PR, target merge EOD Thursday.
michelle.ops: tagging follow-ups in the weekly SRE sync agenda. Please update your ticket status as you progress.
lorna-pm: thanks everyone. quick retrospective note: routing fallback worked but increased latencies for non-enterprise customers. Need to consider cross-region warm pools as a long-term mitigation. Adding to product roadmap discussion. :memo:
michelle.ops: closing out bridge. If any late regressions, reopen thread or ping #oncall. Great coordination — :clap: 
oncall-bridge-bot: Bridge closed by michelle.ops at 2026-03-15T10:00:00Z.
